title: 正文 第四章 生死危机
content_zh:
遗落之地，吞噬无处不在。要想活下去，需要不停的杀戮，掠夺一切，修补己身。

    这——便是此地的生存法则。

    砰！

    一头四臂凶猿倒地，幻天闭目宁息，之后来到一丈多高的凶猿身畔，掏出了一颗黄色兽丹，葡萄大小。幻天运转法门，右脚昆仑穴如同黑洞，兽丹的灵力片刻间便被吞噬一空，化为点点晶光，至他手中消失。

    离开白骨之地后，幻天一直在这残破的古城中游荡，如今已经过去了三天。这三天来他一直都在猎杀凶兽，除了吃饭休息，基本上都是在战斗。

    连续的突破使得他有些根基不牢，这一番酣畅淋漓的战斗正好弥补他提升过快所带来的缺陷。虽然他的修为并没有增长，但幻天却明显感觉到他比三天前强大了太多。

    “果然，在战斗中成长才是最强的。否则只是温室里的花朵。”幻天握拳，气流在指掌间流动，产生了气爆声。

    嗖！

    一道阴影至幻天脚下掠过，似浮光掠影，快到了极致。

    “什么东西？”

    幻天抬首望去，却不见任何身影。而在他看不见的云层上方，一头翼展三丈，头生双角的翼龙雕正俯视着他。

    翼龙雕眼眸空洞，映照幻天身影，待锁定幻天气息后。翼龙雕合拢双翅，状若流星飞矢，双角如同悬顶之剑，破空而来。借助下坠之力，其速度越来越快，已然超越音速，气爆之声轰隆作响，尾浪带动的浮云都在激荡。

    感受到异动，幻天心灵警钟大响，一种致命的生死危机缭绕。一瞬间幻天就已确定，这将是他来到此地遇到的最大一次危机。

    来不及回头，幻天伸展四肢，沟通天地。使用他现在唯一会的古武战技——斗战圣法。

    斗战圣法为战而生，是幻王朝天兵天将的必修课，幻天曾和一位战将学习过。斗战圣法之所以适合所有天兵天将学习，只因它并无修行限制，只是一种理念。故，每人理解的方式不一样，所达到的效果也不一样。斗战圣法，顾名思义就是一个字——战。”

    大巧若拙，大繁弱简，斗战圣法有形的招式只有起手三式。分别是贯、通、破……是熔炼无尽战法和先辈智慧形成的。虽无修行限制，却对肉身要求极高。一共有五重境界，第一重是进攻，毫无保留、一往无前的进攻，狭路相逢勇者胜。第二重是破坏，不能只是毫无用处的进攻，而要在进攻之中融入破坏。剩下的三重分别是旋转、离心、扭曲。一重一腾跃，如若能修行到第五重，可最多提升数十倍战力，不过消耗力惊人，哪怕是突破到肉身极限的肉体也很难长时间使用。

    斗战圣法，只证己身，一切外力都是浮云，关键时刻唯有自身强才是王道。幻天沟通天地，内视己身。在生死危机下，生命潜能被完全发掘。血液奔腾若海，心脏雷动的如同战鼓，三大神穴爆发耀眼光芒。

    “成圣封神。”

    幻天双手划动奇异轨迹，一面光幕迅速成型，光幕上方浮现一道身影，身影乃是幻天的真实投射，是斗战圣法另一种有形的表现。三大神穴爆发灼目光芒，连接光幕，为其提供神力。

    “破。”幻天仰天长啸，最强的防守就是进攻。

    对于这石破天惊的一击，幻天不退反进。双腿微曲，数万斤的力量爆发，幻天似炮弹一样弹射升空。如同蜉蝣撼大树，与体型巨大的翼龙雕砰然相撞。

    这一击似彗星撞地球，绚烂的光芒席卷九重天，在遥远的古城另一边都清晰可见。在如今强者蛰伏的遗落之地，如此庞大的能量波动实属少见，惊动了无数的遗落生物和外来历练的宗门弟子。

    轰隆隆！

    绚烂的光芒之后是震耳欲聋的撞击声。

    三大神穴瞬间黯淡，幻天为自己封的神象破碎，同时翼龙雕的双角也被折断。强大的反震力直接将幻天砸入土层，而翼龙雕也失去平衡，翻滚飞出，在地上犁出了一道深深的沟壑。

    “趁你病，要你命。”幻天吐出一口鲜血，血液中隐隐可以看见内脏碎块。

    幻天深吸一口气，翻身飞出土层，向着翼龙雕飞奔而去。耳边风声怒吼，吹起的衣袂下可看见多处骨茬。幻天顾不得疼痛，他深知一旦等翼龙雕反应过来，在对方的速度优势下，他将无路可逃。
content_en:
In the Forsaken Land, devouring is everywhere. If you want to survive, you need to keep killing, plundering everything, and repairing yourself.

    This——is the law of survival here.

    Bang!

    A four-armed ferocious ape fell to the ground. Huantian closed his eyes and rested peacefully. Then he came to the side of the more than one foot tall ferocious ape and took out a yellow beast pill, the size of a grape. Using the Huantian Turning Technique, the Kunlun point on his right foot was like a black hole. The spiritual power of the beast elixir was swallowed up in a moment, turning into little crystal lights and disappearing in his hand.

    After leaving the Land of Bones, Huantian has been wandering in this dilapidated ancient city, and now three days have passed. He had been hunting ferocious beasts for the past three days. Apart from eating and resting, he was basically fighting.

    Continuous breakthroughs have left him with a weak foundation. This hearty battle just makes up for the shortcomings caused by his rapid improvement. Although his cultivation level has not increased, Huantian clearly feels that he is much stronger than three days ago.

    "Sure enough, those who grow up in battle are the strongest. Otherwise, they are just flowers in the greenhouse." Huantian clenched his fists, and the air flowed between his palms, creating an explosion of air.

    Whoosh!

    A shadow passed by Huantian's feet, like a fleeting light, almost reaching its peak.

    "What?"

    Huantian looked up, but saw no one. And above the clouds that he couldn't see, a pterosaur eagle with a wingspan of three feet and two horns was looking down at him.

    The pterodactyl eagle's eyes are empty, reflecting Huantian's figure, after locking on Huantian's aura. The pterodactyl eagle folds its wings, shaped like a shooting star and a flying arrow, and its horns are like swords hanging from the ceiling, piercing the air. With the help of the force of falling, its speed is getting faster and faster, already exceeding the speed of sound. The sound of air explosion is booming, and the floating clouds driven by the tail wave are stirring.

    Feeling a strange movement, Huantian's spiritual alarm rang loudly, and a fatal life-and-death crisis lingered. In an instant, Huantian was sure that this would be the biggest crisis he would encounter when he came here.

    Before he could turn back in time, Huantian stretched out his limbs and communicated with heaven and earth. Use the only ancient martial arts combat skill he knows now - the holy fighting method.

    The Holy Law of Fighting was born for fighting. It is a required course for the heavenly soldiers and generals of the Huan Dynasty. Huan Tian once studied it with a general. The reason why the holy method of fighting is suitable for all heavenly soldiers and generals to learn is that it has no restrictions on practice and is just a concept. Therefore, everyone understands it differently and achieves different results. The Holy Law of Dou Zhan, as the name suggests, is just one word - war. "

    It's as skillful as it is clumsy, it's complex but weak, and the only tangible moves of Dou Zhan's holy method are the three starting moves. They are penetration, penetration, and destruction... which are formed by smelting endless battle techniques and the wisdom of the ancestors. Although there are no restrictions on practice, it has extremely high requirements on the physical body. There are five levels in total. The first level is attack. Attack without reservation and move forward. The brave will win when encountering a narrow road. The second level is destruction. It cannot just be a useless attack, but must incorporate destruction into the attack. The remaining three are rotation, centrifugation, and twisting. One level and one leap. If you can practice to the fifth level, your combat power can be increased by up to dozens of times. However, the consumption is staggering. Even a body that has broken through to the limit of the physical body will be difficult to use for a long time.

    When fighting against the Holy Law, you can only prove yourself, and all external forces are just clouds. At the critical moment, only one's own strength is the right way. Huantian communicates with heaven and earth and looks inwards at one's own body. In life and death crises, life potential is fully explored. The blood surged like a sea, the heart thundered like a war drum, and the three divine acupoints erupted with dazzling light.

    “Sanctify and become a god. "

    Huantian's hands traced a strange trajectory, and a light curtain quickly took shape. A figure appeared above the light screen. The figure was the true projection of Huantian, and it was another tangible manifestation of the holy law of fighting. The three divine acupoints burst out with dazzling light, connecting to the light curtain and providing it with divine power.

    "Broken. "Huantian looks up to the sky and roars. The strongest defense is offense.

    In response to this earth-shattering blow, Huantian advanced instead of retreating. His legs were slightly bent, tens of thousands of kilograms of power exploded, and Huantian was launched into the air like a cannonball. Like a mayfly shaking a big tree, it collides with a huge pterosaur eagle.

    This strike was like a comet hitting the earth, and the brilliant light swept across the nine heavens, clearly visible on the other side of the distant ancient city. In the Forsaken Land where strong men now lurk, such huge energy fluctuations are rare, alarming countless Forsaken creatures and sect disciples who have experienced outside.

    Boom!

    The brilliant light was followed by a deafening crash.

    The three divine acupoints dimmed instantly, the idol that Huantian sealed for himself was shattered, and the horns of the pterodactyl eagle were also broken. The powerful repulsive force directly smashed Huantian into the soil, and the pterodactyl eagle also lost its balance, rolled and flew out, plowing a deep ravine on the ground.

    “While you are sick, I will kill you. "Huantian spit out a mouthful of blood, and fragments of internal organs could be faintly seen in the blood.

    Huantian took a deep breath, turned over and flew out of the soil, and flew towards the pterosaur eagle. The wind roared in his ears, and many bone stubbles could be seen under the blown clothes. Huantian ignored the pain. He knew that once the pterosaur eagle reacted, he would have no way to escape due to the opponent's speed advantage.
title_en: Text Chapter 4 Life and Death Crisis
